description: Configured 0.10 USD fast specialist operation when runtime commerce is active. Compare two same-form 10-K or 10-Q filings and return source-grounded meaningful changes, explainable decision-relevance triage, low-signal/no-change sections, confidence, limitations, and routing guidance when deeper disclosure verification is warranted. Supply both accessions for an exact pair, or omit both and choose form so FiledProof deterministically selects the latest comparable pair. This is not a legal materiality or investment-significance determination.

earlierAccession.description: Optional earlier SEC accession. Supply together with laterAccession for an exact pair.

focus.description: Optional bounded decision-relevance focus. Defaults to all maintained change categories.

form.description: Comparable SEC form. Defaults to 10-K and must match both explicit filings when accessions are supplied.

history.description: Allow bounded historical SEC submission lookup when automatic pair resolution needs it.

identifier.description: Ticker, CIK, or exact SEC company name.

item.description: Optional SEC filing item such as 1A or 7.

laterAccession.description: Optional later SEC accession. Supply together with earlierAccession for an exact pair.

limit.description: Maximum meaningful change objects to return.

name: filedproof.check_material_filing_changes
title: Check meaningful changes between SEC filings
